questions.question: How does a heavenly restriction usually manifest?
questions.subject: Heavenly Restriction

answer.item: An individual has their innate cursed energy quantity severely limited, up to and including having a complete lack of cursed energy, in exchange for significantly heightened physical abilities.

questions.question: How can a heavenly restriction manifest inversely?
questions.subject: Heavenly Restriction

answer.item: In rarer cases, the inverse may occur: an individual born with an exceptionally weak body may possess greater cursed technique range or higher cursed energy output.
